move: accordion: cards grow in, each expands in turn while others collapse
how: Six equal-width colour cards in a rail, each carrying a vertical rotated label. Cards from() width:0 with expo.out staggered 0.08s, then from 0.157D one card at a time tweens to width 560 while the others shrink to share the remainder (expo.inOut, 0.65s, one card every 0.9s); the vertical label fades out and the big name and hex slide in from x:-30 with expo.out, then fold back with power2.in before the next card opens. At 0.93D all widths return to equal, then the cards collapse to zero width right-to-left with expo.in and the caption fades.
adapt: Swap card colours, names, hex/role strings and the caption; the count drives the STEP grid (1.1 + n*0.9 s) so the duration must scale with it. Keep expo.inOut 0.65s expand and the label fold timings.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .cap and .rail with a .card per shot.colors, and computes REST/OPEN/SMALL from el.clientWidth instead of the hard-coded 1280. animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with t = (1.1 + i*0.9)/7 * D per card; all selectors scoped to el.
caveats: width is animated, which triggers layout each frame
W is computed from a hard-coded 1280px stage width
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when rebuilt
